line_texts.175: **One stable-head correction.** Collect findings on one stable head, group them by root cause, and ship one fail-before/green-after fix. Then request one fresh review of that final head. Do not merge until two of CodeRabbit, CodeAnt, and Codex have covered that head. Do not request a full bot review after every intermediate fix. Another full review only when the code changes again. A false positive that is refuted with evidence and resolved, with no code change, is dispositioned and does not require another full review. Do not push while that head is still being reviewed or tested. A new push makes the previous CI and review evidence stale. Nitpicks and "outside diff range" comments are in scope. Never silence a finding with a new `biome-ignore` / `eslint-disable`. Refactor so the rule passes honestly. `REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE` means a reviewer is skipped, paused, rate limited, quota skipped, on an expired trial, or never attaches a review. It is not a green check, and it is not a merge block once two of CodeRabbit, CodeAnt, and Codex have covered that head. Do not merge a head that none of the three has reviewed. When `chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]` has no non-dismissed review on that head, comment `@codex review` once. Two other reviewers do not replace that request. Do not send a second `@codex review` while that request has not attached a review on that head. A review of an older commit does not cover the head. Follow `docs/PR-REVIEW-LOOP.md`.
